settings.name: font-family
settings.help: font family; repeat for fallbacks, tried in order (an empty value clears the list)

settings.name: font-family-bold
settings.help: family for bold text (default: the font-family's bold, or made from it)

settings.name: font-family-italic
settings.help: family for italic text

settings.name: font-family-bold-italic
settings.help: family for bold italic text

settings.name: font-feature
settings.help: OpenType feature: ss01 or +ss01 on, -calt off, cv01=2 an alternate; repeat for more (an empty value clears them)

settings.name: font-variation
settings.help: variable font axis for regular text, such as wght=450; repeat for more axes (empty clears)

settings.name: font-variation-bold
settings.help: variable font axis for bold text

settings.name: font-variation-italic
settings.help: variable font axis for italic text

settings.name: font-variation-bold-italic
settings.help: variable font axis for bold italic text

settings.name: font-size
settings.help: font size

settings.name: font-ligatures
settings.help: draw the font's ligatures, such as -> and != as arrows and signs, in fonts that have them

settings.name: window-width
settings.help: width of new windows, in cells

settings.name: window-height
settings.help: height of new windows, in cells

settings.name: scrollback-lines
settings.help: lines kept above the screen

settings.name: window-vsync
settings.help: show frames only at a display refresh; false is lower latency but may tear

settings.name: macos-auto-secure-input
settings.help: turn on Secure Keyboard Entry while a program reads a password (input not echoed), so other apps can't read the keys, as in Ghostty

settings.name: undo-timeout
settings.help: how long a closed tab or pane keeps running, hidden, so undo (⌘Z) brings it back as it was: 5s, 500ms, 1m; 0 for never, as in Ghostty. Reopening (⌘⇧T) works after, with new shells

settings.name: quick-terminal-position
settings.help: top, bottom, left, right or center: where the quick terminal (toggle_quick_terminal) appears, as in Ghostty

settings.name: quick-terminal-size
settings.help: how far the quick terminal comes in from its edge, then how much of the edge it runs along (all of it when left out): a percentage of the screen (40%) or points (500px), as in Ghostty; centred, its width then height

settings.name: quick-terminal-autohide
settings.help: hide the quick terminal when another window or app takes the keys

settings.name: macos-option-as-alt
settings.help: true, false, left or right: Option keys that act as Alt instead of typing characters (default: true on US layouts, else false)

settings.name: confirm-close-surface
settings.help: true, false or always: ask before closing a pane, window or mightty (true: only while a command or agent runs in it)

settings.name: font-backend
settings.help: coretext or mightty: who draws glyphs (mightty: our own rasterizer, TrueType fonts; for testing)

settings.name: grapheme-width
settings.help: unicode or legacy: unicode draws emoji written with VS16 (❤️) two cells wide, as Ghostty and kitty do; legacy keeps them one, as shells count them, so command lines with them redraw cleanly

settings.name: window-colorspace
settings.help: srgb or display-p3: the colour space colours and images are taken to be in, as in Ghostty; display-p3 shows them more saturated on a wide-gamut display

settings.name: window-save-state
settings.help: default, never or always: reopen windows, tabs and splits in their directories (default: unless "Close windows when quitting an application" is on in System Settings)

settings.name: auto-update
settings.help: check, download or off: check looks for a new version at launch and once a day and tells you; download also fetches it, ready to install when you choose; off leaves it to Check for Updates in the menu

settings.name: background-opacity
settings.help: opacity of the default background; below 1 the desktop shows through

settings.name: background-blur
settings.help: blur behind a translucent background: true, false or a radius in points

settings.name: window-padding-x
settings.help: space left and right of the text

settings.name: window-padding-y
settings.help: space above and below the text

settings.name: cursor-style
settings.help: block, bar, underline or block_hollow, unless the program picks one

settings.name: cursor-style-blink
settings.help: blink the cursor (default: only when the program asks)

settings.name: adjust-cell-width
settings.help: make cells wider or narrower than the font says: points (1, -1) or a percentage (10%)

settings.name: adjust-cell-height
settings.help: make cells taller or shorter than the font says, for more space between lines: points or a percentage

settings.name: unfocused-split-opacity
settings.help: dim panes keys aren't going to, when a window has several

settings.name: clipboard-read
settings.help: allow, ask or deny: programs reading the clipboard (OSC 52)

settings.name: clipboard-write
settings.help: allow, ask or deny: programs setting the clipboard (OSC 52), as vim, tmux and ssh sessions do to copy

settings.name: copy-on-select
settings.help: copy text to the clipboard as soon as it's selected (true or clipboard)

settings.name: clipboard-paste-protection
settings.help: ask before pasting text with line breaks a shell would run at once, or with control characters

settings.name: mouse-hide-while-typing
settings.help: hide the mouse pointer while typing, until it moves

settings.name: bell-features
settings.help: what a bell does, as in Ghostty: a comma list of system (the alert sound), audio (bell-audio-path), attention (bounce the Dock icon while in the background), title (🔔 on the title until the pane is typed in or looked at) and border (flash the pane's edge); no-NAME turns one off. Default: system,title

settings.name: bell-audio-path
settings.help: a sound file a bell plays with bell-features audio (any format macOS plays: aiff, wav, mp3, m4a)

settings.name: macos-titlebar-style
settings.help: native, transparent (in the terminal's background colour), tabs (tabs in the title bar) or hidden (none, the window dragged by its top padding; tabs, if any, at the top), as in Ghostty

settings.name: scrollbar
settings.help: system or never: system shows macOS's overlay scrollbar at a pane's right edge while scrolling through history, to drag or click, as in Ghostty

settings.name: password-mask
settings.help: show a * for each character typed at a password prompt (a program reading a line without echoing it, as sudo and ssh do), drawn at the cursor by mightty only, so typing can be seen to work

settings.name: mouse-scroll-multiplier
settings.help: scroll this many times as far as the wheel or trackpad says (0.01 to 10000)

settings.name: keybind
settings.help: bind keys to an action, as in Ghostty: cmd+shift+t=new_tab, ctrl+k=unbind, or clear to drop every binding; repeat for more

settings.name: theme
settings.help: colours from themes/NAME in the config directory, or a path; light:NAME,dark:NAME follows macOS's appearance

settings.name: background
settings.help: default background

settings.name: foreground
settings.help: default text colour

settings.name: cursor-color
settings.help: cursor (default: the text colour under it)

settings.name: cursor-text
settings.help: text under a block cursor (default: the cell's background)

settings.name: selection-background
settings.help: background of selected text

settings.name: selection-foreground
settings.help: selected text (default: unchanged)

settings.name: search-foreground
settings.help: text of search matches

settings.name: search-background
settings.help: background of search matches

settings.name: search-selected-foreground
settings.help: text of the selected search match

settings.name: search-selected-background
settings.help: background of the selected search match

settings.name: palette
settings.help: palette entry N (0-255); repeat for more entries

settings.name: command
settings.help: run this shell command line in the first window instead of a login shell

settings.name: working-directory
settings.help: working directory of the first window (default: home)

actions.name: new_window
actions.help: A new window, its shell where the current one is

actions.name: new_tab
actions.help: A new tab, its shell where the current one is

actions.name: new_split:right
actions.help: Splits the pane, the new one to the right

actions.name: new_split:down
actions.help: Splits the pane, the new one below

actions.name: close_surface
actions.help: Closes the pane, or its tab or window with its last pane

actions.name: close_window
actions.help: Closes the window

actions.name: minimize_window
actions.help: Minimizes the window

actions.name: quit
actions.help: Quits Mightty

actions.name: copy_to_clipboard
actions.help: Copies the selection

actions.name: paste_from_clipboard
actions.help: Pastes, asking first when it could run commands

actions.name: start_search
actions.help: Finds text in the pane and its history

actions.name: navigate_search:next
actions.help: The next match (or previous)

actions.name: goto_split:next
actions.help: The next pane (or previous)

actions.name: goto_split:left
actions.help: The pane to the left (or right, up, down)

actions.name: resize_split:left,10
actions.help: Moves the nearest divider, in points

actions.name: toggle_split_zoom
actions.help: The pane alone fills the window, or not

actions.name: equalize_splits
actions.help: Shares the window evenly between its panes

actions.name: goto_tab:1
actions.help: Tab N, from 1

actions.name: previous_tab
actions.help: The tab to the left

actions.name: next_tab
actions.help: The tab to the right

actions.name: last_tab
actions.help: The last tab

actions.name: move_tab_to_new_window
actions.help: The tab out into a window of its own

actions.name: close_other_tabs
actions.help: Closes the window's other tabs

actions.name: undo
actions.help: Brings back the last tab, pane or window closed, still running, within undo-timeout

actions.name: reopen_closed
actions.help: Reopens the last tab, pane or window closed, running still or with new shells

actions.name: prompt_surface_title
actions.help: A title for the pane, shown in its tab and window

actions.name: jump_to_attention
actions.help: The pane that has waited longest for you

actions.name: toggle_command_palette
actions.help: Every action by name, filtered as you type

actions.name: toggle_quick_terminal
actions.help: A terminal that drops from the top of the screen, over any app

actions.name: toggle_secure_input
actions.help: Secure Keyboard Entry: other apps can't read what you type

actions.name: about
actions.help: Shows Mightty's version and licence

actions.name: check_for_updates
actions.help: Checks for a newer version of Mightty and offers to install it

actions.name: open_settings
actions.help: The settings, in a window of their own

actions.name: open_config
actions.help: The config file in your $EDITOR, in a new tab

actions.name: reload_config
actions.help: Applies the config file now

actions.name: increase_font_size:1
actions.help: A bigger font in the pane, by points (or smaller)

actions.name: reset_font_size
actions.help: The pane's font back to font-size

actions.name: clear_screen
actions.help: Clears history and the screen above the prompt

actions.name: scroll_to_top
actions.help: To the top of the history

actions.name: scroll_to_bottom
actions.help: Back to the prompt

actions.name: scroll_page_up
actions.help: A page up the history

actions.name: scroll_page_down
actions.help: A page down the history

actions.name: text:hello\n
actions.help: Sends text to the program (\n, \r, \t, \e, \xHH)

actions.name: csi:2J
actions.help: Sends ESC [ and the text

actions.name: esc:d
actions.help: Sends ESC and the text

actions.name: ignore
actions.help: The key does nothing, not even reach the program
